DependencyListResponse.description:
A task's direct finish-to-start dependencies (full rows, so the client
renders "blocked by" without extra fetches).

curated_fields.description: CI5: human-set tier; sticky forever, never auto-overwritten.

field_sources.description: CI5: per observed field `{source_system, source_link_id, observed_at}`.

fields.description:
Custom-field values validated against the layout's schema
(docs-platform v1 shape; app-validated). The EFFECTIVE view:
curated wins over observed (CI5, migration 0061).

identity_keys.description: CI3 deterministic identity keys (source GUID, serial, MACs, ...).

kind.description:
Free-text connector compatibility column; typed classification
lives in `layout_id` + `fields` (asset taxonomy, migration 0054).

layout_id.description: The typed layout this asset instantiates; NULL = untyped.

merged_into_id.description: CI4: non-NULL means this row was absorbed by the target (tombstone).

observed_fields.description: CI5: feed-written tier; churns silently with its source.

purchase_fx_rate_used.description:
FX conversion snapshot (ADR 0002 lock moment: inventory receipt) —
locked once when the purchase cost is written in a non-base
currency; immutable afterwards (DB trigger enforced).

DispatchAppointment.description:
One booking block on the dispatch board: the appointment plus the
ticket number and client name the block face renders.

oneOf.description:
Latest field-service status push against this booking (dispatch v2,
additive): `None` when nothing was pushed yet.

DispatchDayQuery.description:
One dispatch-path query: `date` is a LOCAL date interpreted as the
UTC day window (documented UTC scope).

date.description: The day to assemble; defaults to today (UTC).

DispatchDayView.description: The assembled day-view payload: one request, one render.

unassigned.description:
Unassigned, non-closed tickets in dispatch order (priority rank,
then effective SLA/due deadline).

DispatchStatusShade.description:
The latest connector/staff status push for one booking, shaded onto
the board block face.

Document.description:
A document's living handle. No content lives here — content is only
ever a [`DocumentVersion`]; `current_version` names the newest one.

client_id.description:
NULL = org-global document; set = client-scoped (docs-platform v1,
migration 0053).

current_version.description: The newest version number in the document's history.

fields.description: Custom-field values validated against the layout's schema.

layout_id.description: The typed layout this document instantiates; NULL = untyped.

DocumentLayout.description:
An org-managed document/asset type. System layouts (the seeded
standard MSP set) are editable but not deletable.

oneOf.description:
CI6: the behavior-bearing semantic class this type is bound to
(ADR 0003, migration 0061). Renaming the layout never changes
behavior; identity keys and field schema read this class.

client_id.description:
Scope narrow: a client uuid, or the literal `global` for org-wide
documents (docs-platform v1). Absent = all scopes.

q.description: Title substring narrowing; ranked full-text search rides /api/search.

DocumentMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): document fields at the top
level plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

DocumentVersion.description:
One immutable snapshot in a document's append-only history. Every
version stores its complete title + body, so any pair is diffable
without reconstructing intermediate state.

change_summary.description: Optional human explanation of what changed in this version.

restored_from_version.description:
Set when this version was created by a RESTORE: the historical
version whose content was copied. Restore-creates-new-version is
the only way old content comes back — history is never rewritten.

DocumentView.description:
GET /api/documents/{id} response: the living handle plus the CURRENT
version's content (read-your-write on the body the last write stored).

label.description: Free-form run label recorded with the dry-run history entry.

template_id.description:
Optional saved field-mapping template: source headers are renamed to
the template's canonical columns before validation (D2 remainder).

DryRunRequest.description:
POST /api/imports/dry-run request: validate a full payload and report
what each row WOULD do before any data write. The probe is recorded as a
finished dry-run batch for operator history.

DunningState.description:
Collections posture of an issued invoice. Forward-only: states are
data moved by explicit API writes (events + write trail), never a
background side effect.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key +
If-Match `version` on the invoice.

to_state.description:
The target state; must be strictly forward on the ladder
(skipping rungs is allowed).

actions.description: AutomationAction documents, parsed and validated via core-domain.

EmailDeliveryView.description:
Delivery projection from the `email_outbound` ledger. Present for
outbound rows only — inbound mail has no send lifecycle.

EmailDirection.description: Whether a message entered (inbound) or left (outbound) the system.

EmailMessage.description:
One persisted email message. `rfc_message_id` is unique per org and is
the idempotency key for inbound processing; `email_refs` carries the
RFC 5322 References chain (`references` itself is reserved SQL).

transport.description: Which transport adapter handled the message (postmark/smtp/…).

EntityKind.description:
Which entity family a batch targets. One batch = exactly one kind; the
parent-before-child ordering across batches keeps foreign references
resolvable without cross-batch transactions. D2 remainder extends the
original client/site/contact family with boards, tickets, and time
entries: [`Self::import_order`] is the documented run-script order.

EscalationStep.description: One escalation ladder step as stored (`sla_escalation_steps`).

notify_user_ids.description: Extra recipients beyond the ticket assignee.

bundle_version.description: Envelope schema version. Bump ONLY for breaking section reshapes.

sections.description: The export sections. Always fully serialized.

restricted_to.description:
Optional visibility restriction: when non-empty, only these users
(plus admins) can see the client. Opaque user-id references.

kind.description: Structured note taxonomy: internal | client_visible | in_house_update.

ExportContact.description: One contact row; `client_id`/`site_id` reference this bundle.

bundle_version.description: Envelope version of the produced bundle (mirrors the body).

download_url.description:
Self-contained relative URL carrying the signature + expiry; the
client prefixes its API origin. Works without a bearer token.

sha256.description: sha256 of the stored bytes (download integrity check).

size_bytes.description: Exact bundle byte size as stored.

ExportFieldValue.description: One typed custom-field value attached to any entity row.

entity.description:
Field-definition family the value belongs to (ticket | client |
contact | asset) — resolved from the definition at load time.

value.description: The typed value exactly as stored (JSONB passthrough).

ExportSections.description:
Section container — all fields always present; empty org state is an
empty array, never an absent key.

custom_field_values.description:
Every custom-field VALUE in the org, flat across entity families —
the data plane the U5 manifest deliberately excludes. `entity` names
the family the field definition attaches to (ticket | client |
contact | asset); `entity_id` is the owning row.

customization.description:
The U5 customization-manifest sections, embedded verbatim — D1 is
the manifest's generalization, not its replacement.

org.description:
Org profile identity (volatile counters excluded — a restore
reseeds the ticket-number sequence from the imported tickets).

tickets.description:
Tickets with their comments nested. Parents (client/site/contact)
are referenced by id into the sections above.

ExportSite.description: One site row; `client_id` references `clients` in this bundle.

ExportTicket.description:
One ticket with its comment thread nested. Authorship is an opaque
user-id reference; the bundle never carries user records.

category.description:
Semantic category of the captured status (behavior binds to this,
never to the status label).

number.description: Human number (e.g. "MER-12") — the bundle's stable ticket key.

ExportTimeEntry.description:
One time entry; `ticket_id` and `user_id` reference this bundle's
tickets and the org's live users respectively.

allOf.description: Instant-first mutation parameters (IF1).

identity_keys.description: CI3 deterministic identity signals (source GUID, serial, MACs, ...).

observed_fields.description: CI5 observed tier: feed-written, churns with its source.

tag.description: Display defaults for a freshly created canonical item.

FeedUpsertRequest.description: The feeder upsert input — lane 8's seam (NinjaOne / IT Glue / Auvik).

auto_merged.description: Auto-merged at/above the org confidence threshold.

contradictions.description: Observed values that contradict a curated value (never applied).

created_item.description: A fresh canonical row was created by THIS sync (no twin risk).

queued_candidates.description: Reviewable candidates queued for a human (visible evidence).

resolved_existing.description:
An existing item was deterministically resolved through identity
keys; no second row exists for this source record.

FeedUpsertResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): item fields flattened at the top
level plus the additive feed-sync evidence and `mutation` metadata.

FieldDefView.description:
Wire view of one field definition; choice kinds carry their closed
option set so generated clients can render editors directly.

board_id.description: Owning board (`None` = org-wide; v1 always creates board-scoped).

options.description: Closed option set for select/multiselect; empty otherwise.

FieldKindWire.description:
The definition kinds (mirror of migration 0009's CHECK set). Kept as a
string-newtype wire enum so unknown kinds fail validation, not deserialization.

FieldResolution.description:
Per-field resolution: which side's value wins when the tickets
disagree. `"survivor"` (the default) keeps the survivor's value.

FilterOp.description:
Filter operators supported by the v1 compiled reports. Operand typing is
enforced through [`ValueType`] matches in the builder, so e.g. a bool
operand can never reach a timestamp column. The serde encoding is the
`snake_case` slug (`lt_eq`, `is_null`, …) stored specs carry.

FilterValue.description:
A typed filter operand. The variant must match the catalog
[`ValueType`] of the filtered column (`Int` covers both Int and BigInt
columns) — enforced by [`ReportSpec::validate`], so a mismatched
operand can never reach a bind. The serde encoding is the externally
tagged slug (`{"text": "p1"}`, `{"bool": true}`).

oneOf.description: RFC 3339 instant (chrono serde encoding).
`YYYY-MM-DD`.

FxRateEntry.description: One `fx_rates` row: append-only; corrections add rows, never rewrite.

base_currency.description: 1 base major unit buys `rate` quote major units.

source.description: 'manual' for the built-in provider; managed feeds stamp their own.

FxReconciliationRow.description:
One `ops.v1_fx_reconciliation` row — the FX deliverable to the books
(FX7): original amount, rate, source/date, base equivalent, sync
target. The core records conversions that happened; realized/unrealized
gain-loss stays in the accounting system.

sync_target.description:
The accounting export target ('none' until a deployment configures
one — qbo-export-sync / xero-export-sync are per-deployment).

nudge_sent_at.description: When the EOD run nudged for this day, if it did.

from.description: Inclusive local-day start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday.

user_id.description: Manager report only: whose days. Requires owner/admin.

HeartbeatRequest.description:
POST /api/presence/heartbeat body. One heartbeat per viewer per entity
instance every ~30s; entries expire after 90s without one (TTL is
server-side, see `realtime::presence`).

editing.description: True while the caller is actively editing (vs. just viewing).

IncidentView.description: The storm group behind an incident ticket.

alert_count.description: How many alerts have collapsed into this ticket so far.

attributes.description: Provider-specific structured context (must be a JSON object).

correlation_key.description:
Storm grouping key; defaults to `dedup_key` when absent so
uncorrelated alerts each anchor their own incident.

dedup_key.description: Provider's per-event identity. REQUIRED: this is the replay gate.

occurred_at.description: When the condition started (defaults to receipt time).

IngestResponse.description: POST /api/alerts/ingest — outcome of one signed delivery.

oneOf.description:
Present for `incident_created` and `collapsed`; `None` when the
anchor ticket vanished before a replay answered.

status.description:
`incident_created` (this alert anchored a NEW incident ticket),
`collapsed` (folded into the still-open storm incident), or
`duplicate` (replayed dedup_key — the stored alert is returned,
nothing was written).

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + entity
version (of the newly created project). Absent in legacy clients —
purely additive.

assignee_map.description:
Resolves template `assignee_key`s to user ids at instantiation
time; unmapped keys simply leave those tasks unassigned.

IntegrationLinkStatus.description: Per-connector link state as data (linked/unlinked + last touch).

InviteInfo.description:
The one-time setup token an admin delivers to the invitee (shown once;
only its sha-256 is stored).

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key.

role.description: Builtin org role: owner, admin, dispatcher, technician, read_only.

Invoice.description:
The billing document. Derives from exactly one contract; `currency`
and `total_minor` come from the contract's evaluation (line sum).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code copied from the contract; every amount uses it.

fx_rate_used.description:
FX conversion snapshot (ADR 0002 lock moment: invoice issue) —
locked once at the issue leg when currency ≠ org base; immutable
afterwards. `base_total_minor` is the issue-time base equivalent.

number.description: Human invoice number, unique per org (e.g. "INV-000042").

period_from.description:
The billed period, when the contract type has one (recurring /
retainer / T&M window slice); `None` for fixed-fee schedules.

run_id.description: The run that created this invoice (`None` for future manual invoices).

total_minor.description: Sum of line amounts, minor units.

InvoiceDetail.description: The invoice aggregate: document, lines, and payment receipts.

InvoiceLine.description:
One persisted billing line; mirrors the engine's `BillingCandidateLine`
(kind reuse via [`crate::entities::BillingLineKind`]) minus the
denormalized contract/client names.

fx_rate_used.description:
FX conversion snapshot (ADR 0002 lock moment: time-entry costing —
the run pricing labor into this line) when currency ≠ org base.

quantity_minutes.description: Labor minutes on the line (T&M / overage); 0 for amount lines.

InvoiceMutationResponse.description: Instant-first mutation response (IF2) for invoice mutations.

InvoicePayment.description:
A payment receipt recorded through the `PaymentProvider` seam. The
provider stays a string (`none` in v1 — the built-in provider approves
locally without external PSP calls).

fx_rate_used.description:
FX conversion snapshot (ADR 0002 lock moment: payment settlement) —
locked once at receipt when currency ≠ org base; immutable after.

InvoiceRun.description:
The invoice-run batch record: one evaluation sweep over a window and
the roll-up of the invoices it created.

currency.description:
Currency of the summed total; `None` when the run created no
invoices (mixed currencies are rejected before any write).

number.description: Human run number, unique per org (e.g. "RUN-000007").

InvoiceRunResponse.description: Instant-first mutation response (IF2) for an invoice run.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code — required for free-standing credits; when
`invoice_id` is set it must match the invoice's currency.

invoice_id.description:
The invoice the credit is raised against (issuing context). When
set, the credit's currency is the invoice's.

IssuedInvoice.description: One issued invoice: the document plus its lines.

category_id.description: Survives category deletion (the FK is ON DELETE SET NULL).

client_visible.description: The article half of the client-facing gate (portal v2 honors it).

KbArticleStatus.description:
Article lifecycle. Closed vocabulary so filtering and the client-facing
rule stay deterministic: `draft` (staff authoring), `published`
(readable, searchable), `archived` (retired, out of the active tree —
content edits are refused while archived; unarchive to edit).

KbCategory.description: A KB category: grouping + ordering for the article tree.

client_visible.description:
The category half of the client-facing gate: an article is visible
to portal clients only when this AND the article flag are set (and
the article is published).

slug.description:
Stable per-org handle (unique); portals and imports reference this,
never the row id.

at_pct.description: Fires when consumed budget reaches this percent (1..=500).

LayoutField.description:
One field in a layout's schema. The `fields` column stores an array of
these (as JSON); the API validates document `fields` objects against
them.

type.description: text | number | date | bool | select | url | email

LinkKind.description:
Either endpoint of a link. Documents, passwords, and assets can link
FROM; documents, passwords, clients, tickets, KB articles, and assets
can be linked TO (asset kind added in migration 0054).

semantic_class.description:
CI6 semantic class filter (workstation | server | vm |
network_appliance | printer | iot).

include_retired.description:
Include retired nodes (admin editors + the manifest want them;
pickers default to false).

LoginResponse.description:
Login outcome: tokens directly, or a short-lived MFA bridge token when
any second factor is enrolled. Untagged so legacy clients that ignore
`mfa_required` keep parsing the plain token pair they always got.

methods.description: Second factors able to satisfy this login.

MaintenanceWindow.description:
Planned downtime: an absolute UTC interval during which SLA clocks do
not consume business-time budget (vendor maintenance, change freezes).

ManifestApiKey.description:
API-key metadata. `key_hash` (the credential verifier) and the raw key
material are structurally absent — only the display prefix survives.

board_id.description: Board the rule is scoped to; null = every board in the org.

trigger_event.description: Domain event type from the envelope, e.g. `ticket.created`.

require_checklist_close.description: Pre-close checklist enforcement toggle (workflow discipline flag).

statuses.description:
Custom statuses; ALWAYS one per semantic category (defaults-first
seeding guarantees category coverage, never removed by edits).

transitions.description:
Explicit transition adjacency between this board's statuses. Empty
means the semantic-category floor applies (any→any except identity
and closed→open), not "no transitions".

ManifestBoardStatus.description:
One custom status, bound to its semantic category. Renames and colors
never change behavior — consumers must branch on `category`, not `name`.

category.description:
Semantic category: open | in_progress | waiting | closed. THE
binding every SLA/automation/reporting behavior keys on.

is_entry.description: Tickets may enter this status directly at creation.

client_name.description: Stable semantic sort key (ids only break ties across re-imports).

value.description:
The typed payload (uuid string for reference kinds, boolean for
toggles); `null` when `disabled`.

ManifestCustomField.description:
One custom field definition. `config` is the kind-specific document
(select options, validation bounds, …) exactly as stored.

archived_at.description:
Present when the definition was archived (still a customization the
preflight must see; the values it shaped may still exist).

entity.description: Entity the field attaches to: ticket | client | contact | asset.

kind.description: Field kind: text | number | date | select | multiselect | bool | url | user.

at_pct.description: Percent of the target's business-time budget consumed at firing.

notify_user_ids.description: JSON array of user ids to notify.

ManifestReportDefinition.description:
One stored report definition (TASKLIST R3). The spec body rides as its
stored jsonb document (`{filters, group_by, measures}`) exactly like
custom-field `config` — the registry-validated view/viz slugs travel as
their own fields so a preflight can flag deprecated constructs without
re-deriving validation. Nothing here is secret-bearing: definitions
reference the read-model catalog only, never credentials or data.

scope.description:
Visibility scope: `org` (published org-wide) or `self` (private to
the creator; admins see all). Preflight-relevant because org-scope
definitions are shared surface, self-scope ones are personal.

spec.description: Spec body document: `{filters, group_by, measures}` as stored.

ManifestSections.description:
Section container. All fields are always present; empty org state is an
empty array, never an absent key. New sections append here.

api_keys.description: API-key metadata minus secret material (no hashes, no raw keys).

boards.description:
Per-board workflow: the board identity plus its statuses (each bound
to a semantic category — the defaults-first guarantee) and its
explicit transition adjacency. An EMPTY transitions array means the
semantic-category floor applies, not "no transitions".

client_workflow_overrides.description:
Per-client workflow overrides (Wave 12 lane 5): every client-scoped
override of the org workflow defaults, rows verbatim. The override
registry (`core_domain::workflow_overrides`) is the closed key set;
the preflight must see which constructs each client's rows reference
so a migration touching those constructs transforms the rows in the
same transaction (§4.5).

custom_fields.description:
Custom field definitions across all entities (tickets, clients,
contacts, assets), including archived ones.

report_definitions.description:
Stored report definitions (TASKLIST R3): registry-validated specs
over the versioned read-model views. Covered so the upgrade
preflight (U6) can flag any definition whose `kind`/spec columns
reference deprecated view or column constructs (policy §5).

settings.description:
Org-scope settings-registry overrides (user-scope rows are per-user
preferences, not org customization).

sla.description: SLA configuration: calendars and policies with escalation ladders.

taxonomy.description:
Ticket type/category/subcategory trees (Wave 11 lane 3).
Classification-only (§5): exported so the preflight sees the full
classification surface; retired rows INCLUDED (tickets may still
reference them). Categories are flat — `parent_id` reconstructs
the exactly-two-level tree.

webhooks.description: Webhook subscriptions with event-type filters, never secrets.

ManifestSlaCalendar.description: One named SLA calendar row with its flattened business calendar body.

calendar.description: Timezone / weekday windows / holidays / maintenance document.

ManifestSlaPolicy.description:
One SLA policy with its targets document, embedded fallback calendar,
calendar attachment, and escalation ladder.

calendar.description: Embedded fallback calendar; governs while `calendar_id` is null.

calendar_id.description: Attached named calendar; null keeps the embedded one authoritative.

targets.description: Targets document keyed by priority string.

ManifestTaxonomy.description: The two classification trees of one org.

ManifestTaxonomyCategory.description: One category (root when `parent_id` is null) or subcategory.

ManifestTransition.description: One allowed status change, `from` → `to`, both ids from the SAME board.

ManifestWebhook.description:
One webhook subscription. The HMAC signing secret is structurally
absent: it exists only at creation time and in the sealed column.

event_types.description: Event-type filter; empty array = wildcard (all event types).

marked.description: Rows flipped from unread to read (idempotent under retry).

MatchCandidate.description:
One technician candidate for one ticket: the skills this candidate is
missing (an empty list = fully qualified right now).

MatchQuery.description: GET /api/dispatch/match query: how many unassigned tickets to match.

MeetingAssigneeScope.description:
Who a meeting type books against: ONE user's calendar, or the
unioned availability of a free-form admin-defined group.

MeetingType.description:
A bookable template: duration, buffer before/after, booking window,
org-editable free-form `parameters`, and the assignee scope. Auto-
email is per-template; with transport `none` the send is skipped.

parameters.description:
Free-form org-edited payload (location hint, agenda, questions…).
Consumers must tolerate any shape; nothing in behavior keys off it.
Free-form org-edited payload (location hint, agenda, questions…).

mfa_token.description: The `mfa_token` from POST /api/auth/login when mfa_required was set.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + version.

reset_sla.description:
Default false: the existing SLA clock state is PRESERVED verbatim
(board membership is classification, not a lifecycle event). true =
re-initialize the clocks under the org's default policy anchored at
the move moment.

status_id.description:
Pin the target status explicitly (the retry path after a
`board_move_status_conflict`). Must be a status of the target
board; omitted = remap through the semantic categories.

MoveSpec.description: One move in a batch: the booking's new user and slot.

MutationMeta.description:
Read-your-write metadata every mutation response carries (IF2), merged
as the additive `mutation` object alongside the entity fields.

before.description:
Prior entity snapshot (the undo substrate). `null` on creates. The
OpenAPI schema stays a plain object; generated clients get the
runtime-typed view through the SDK's `snapshotOf` accessor.

idempotency_key.description:
The idempotency key that claimed this result, when the caller
supplied one.

seq.description:
Monotonic per-entity sequence: strictly increases by one per
applied write, so clients order reconciliations against the event
stream.

version.description:
Version token for If-Match-style writes; mirrors `seq`. Echo it in
the next write's `version` field.

MutationParams.description:
The autosave mutation parameters every gated create/update body carries
(flattened into the request struct — purely additive fields).

idempotency_key.description:
Idempotency key: the same key with the same payload replays the
SAME stored result (never double-applies); the same key with a
different payload is a typed 409. Generate one per user edit
debounce/retry episode (UUID works).

version.description:
If-Match-style version: the entity `version` the caller last saw
(the `mutation.version` of the previous response). A mismatch
rejects the write with a typed 409 `version_conflict` carrying
`expected`/`provided`; omit for creates and for legacy callers.

MyWorkItem.description:
One cross-board my-work queue row (TASKLIST 2.11): the ticket plus the
annotations the Today screen renders per the mockup.

board_id.description: The source board of this cross-board row.

client_name.description: Client short label for the squared tag (`None` = internal ticket).

due_at.description: Manual deadline set on the ticket itself.

sla_resolution_due.description:
SLA resolution deadline when state exists; the UI prefers this over
`due_at` for the right-aligned countdown column.

NotificationPage.description: One page of the inbox plus the cursor to continue with.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` on the next request; `None` means exhausted.

name.description: URL path segment used by login/link routes.

OnCallBlock.description: An absolute UTC on-call rotation segment for one user.

OrgBillingPreview.description:
Org-wide preview: every billable contract's evaluation for the window
plus the grand total — the shape a Wave-9 invoice run will consume.

total_minor.description: Sum over evaluations, minor units (mixed currencies reject).

base_currency.description: The org's ONE base (reporting) currency (ADR 0002, FX1).

OrgUser.description:
Directory view of one staff user (route-level DTO; `org_role` is the
user's highest-precedence builtin role, `null` for custom-only).

oneOf.description: Present on invite only: the setup token for the invitee.

OrgUserMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): the invited (still inactive)
user at the top level plus the one-time setup token and the additive
`mutation` metadata.

OverrideDeclarationView.description: One registry declaration, projected for the settings/admin surface.

org_default_setting.description: The settings-registry key carrying the org default for toggles.

OverrideEntry.description:
One resolved override entry: the declaration it validated against, the
resolution outcome, which layer supplied it, the raw org default and client
row, the renderable detail, and any resolution issues (e.g. a stale
cross-board status override that fell back to the board's entry status).

issues.description: Typed drift/validation notes (never empty on a fallback).

org_default.description: The org default this resolution inherited from, when one existed.

source.description: Which layer supplied the effective value.

OverrideValueKind.description:
The value shapes a client override accepts. The wire value is the plain
JSON payload (uuid string / boolean); the kind exists so validation can
reject a mistyped payload before persistence.

user_id.description: Owner of the row being deleted (must match self-or-admin rule).

PasswordEntry.description:
A vault credential. `secret_ciphertext` is AES-256-GCM from
core-api crypto::seal — plaintext NEVER reaches the database layer,
and this entity never carries it either (reveal is a dedicated,
audited endpoint response type).

PasswordHistoryEntry.description: One archived secret ciphertext from a credential's change history.

merged_into_ticket_id.description:
Merge marker (Wave 11 lane 9): the survivor this ticket folded
into, when it was absorbed by a merge. The row stays queryable
(doctrine #9) but is closed and never re-opened.

type_id.description:
Classification (Wave 11 lane 3; read-view exposure Wave 12 lane 6):
the org taxonomy nodes carried on the ticket. PATCH accepts them;
the read view now returns them so ticket detail can display the
current classification. Purely descriptive — classification-only
doctrine (§5) binds behavior to semantic categories, never these.

the top level (unchanged shape) plus the read-your-write metadata for
the affected item.

GET response for a ticket's checklist: instances, derived progress,
and the board's live enforcement posture. `blocking` lists the unchecked
REQUIRED items when enforcement is active (empty otherwise).

A structured ticket note. Taxonomy: internal / client-visible /
in-house update. `kind` gates portal visibility and email fan-out.

fx_rate_used.description:

set once at entry when currency ≠ org base; immutable afterwards.

reply_to_message_id.description:
The id of the message INSIDE THIS TICKET this row replies to,
resolved case-insensitively against the ledger's Message-IDs.
`null` when the parent is unknown or lives on another ticket.

TicketEmailRow.description:
One ledger message as the timeline renders it: the full `EmailMessage`
shape (unchanged, additive only) plus the delivery projection and the
resolved in-ticket reply parent.

messages.description: Newest-first, mirroring the ledger's thread view.

TicketExpense.description: One expense entry on a ticket.

fx_rate_used.description:
FX conversion snapshot (ADR 0002 lock moment: expense entry) —
set once at entry when currency ≠ org base; immutable afterwards.

TicketFieldInput.description:
One value assignment on a ticket create/patch: raw JSON validated against
its definition server-side.

TicketLinkType.description:
A typed edge between two tickets.

- `ParentChild`: `from_ticket_id` is the CHILD, `to_ticket_id` the
  parent — child work rolls up to the parent.
- `MajorIncident`: `from_ticket_id` is a MEMBER, `to_ticket_id` the
  major incident it folded into.

tags.description:
Comma-separated tag ids (Wave 11 lane 9): AND semantics — tickets
must carry every listed tag.

candidates.description: Active technicians sorted best-first (fewest missing, then name).

TicketMatch.description:
Skills-matched staffing for one unassigned ticket. Tickets with no
required skills are not listed (the plain queue ordering covers them).

TicketMutationResponse.description:

top level (unchanged shape) plus the additive `mutation` metadata — the
applied snapshot, monotonic per-entity `seq`/`version`, and the prior
and new values that make undo a core capability.

TicketNumber.description:
Human-facing ticket number, e.g. `MER-2841`. Globally unique per org,
assigned from a per-org sequence.

TicketRevertResponse.description:
The reverted ticket with the mutation envelope, plus what was reverted.
Deserializable so an IF1 idempotent replay can reconstruct the exact
stored response.

TicketRollup.description:
Rollup over the children/members pointing at one ticket, plus the
ticket's own billable money lines.

billable_cost_minor.description: Summed minor-unit total of billable cost lines + expenses.

child_open_count.description: Open (not closed, not merged) children still carrying work.

time_minutes.description: Summed minutes of folded-in time (own + children/members).

TicketSlaState.description:
Per-ticket SLA clock state. Accumulates paused business seconds so a
Waiting stretch does not consume the resolution budget.

paused_business_secs.description: Business seconds accumulated while the clock was paused.

paused_since.description: When the current pause began (None while running).

TicketSlaStatus.description: Live SLA clock readout for one ticket (badge + countdown surfaces).

applied.description:
False when no SLA policy applies to the ticket — a typed empty
state, never a 404 (the endpoint is polled by the ticket header).

minutes_remaining.description: Business minutes left on the resolution budget (negative = over).

paused.description: True while a Waiting-category pause is open.

TicketStatusCategory.description:
The four semantic categories every ticket status maps to (§5).
Customization (labels, ordering, per-board sets) can never add, remove, or
re-bind these: SLA timers, pause logic, automations, billing, and reports
bind to the category, not the label.

TicketStatusMutationResponse.description: Same additive envelope for status transitions (plain ticket body).

TicketWithFields.description: A ticket payload enriched with its custom-field values (detail + list).

or entered manually; subject to bulk review and approval workflows.

timer_session_id.description: Origin: timer-derived entries keep their session for audit.

time_gap_min_minutes.description: Active days logging under this many minutes are gap days.

(unchanged shape) plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

ended_at.description: None while this segment is running.

reason.description: Free-text reason recorded at pause time ("on call with vendor").

TimerSession.description:
One user's timer against one ticket. At most one session per user is
ever running — enforced by [`TimerSession::start_switch`].

otpauth_url.description: Standard otpauth:// URI (renderable as QR by clients).

belong to statuses of the SAME board (enforced here, and by composite FKs
in storage).

post.summary:
POST /api/auth/login — resolves the org by email (SECURITY DEFINER
bridge), verifies the argon2 hash under RLS scope. When any second
factor is enrolled, returns a short-lived `mfa_pending` bridge instead
of tokens; POST /api/auth/mfa/verify completes it.
POST /api/auth/logout — revokes the refresh session and audits the event.

POST /api/auth/mfa/recovery-codes/regenerate — invalidates all previous
codes, issues a new batch (revealed once).

POST /api/auth/mfa/totp/disable — requires password AND a live factor;
wipes TOTP enrollment and all recovery codes.

POST /api/auth/mfa/totp/enroll-begin — generates a secret (returned ONCE)
and stores it sealed+unconfirmed. Re-calling restarts enrollment safely.

POST /api/auth/mfa/totp/enroll-verify — confirms the enrollment with the
first valid code and issues the one-time recovery-code batch.

POST /api/auth/mfa/verify — completes an MFA-gated login with a TOTP or
recovery code. Tries TOTP first (advancing the replay watermark), then
falls back to single-use recovery codes.

POST /api/auth/mfa/webauthn/begin — assertion request for the pending
MFA login. Requires a valid mfa_pending token.

POST /api/auth/mfa/webauthn/register/begin — starts a passkey
registration for the authenticated user.

POST /api/auth/mfa/webauthn/register/finish — verifies the attestation
and stores the passkey. The public key is stored; no secret exists.
